name: Christ the Redeemer
description: An Art Deco statue of Christ overlooks Rio from Corcovado peak.

name: Sugarloaf Mountain
description: Cable cars climb granite sugarloaf peaks above Guanabara Bay.

name: Cathedral of Brasília
description: Oscar Niemeyer’s crown-shaped cathedral stands on the monumental axis.

name: São Paulo Cathedral
description: A neo-Gothic cathedral anchors Praça da Sé in central São Paulo.

name: Church of São Francisco
description: Ornate gilded interiors fill this baroque church in Salvador’s Pelourinho.

name: Iguaçu Falls
description: A vast waterfall system on the Argentina–Brazil border with walkways on both sides.

name: Manaus riverfront
description: Gateway city to the Amazon with a historic opera house and river boats.

name: Copacabana Beach
description: A curved beach with wave-pattern promenade tiles along Rio’s south zone.

name: Lençóis Maranhenses
description: White dunes and seasonal rainwater lagoons in Maranhão.

name: Pantanal wetlands
description: One of the world’s large tropical wetlands, known for wildlife viewing.

name: Mercado Municipal
description: São Paulo’s municipal market is famous for mortadella sandwiches and tropical fruit.

name: Feira de São Cristóvão
description: A northeastern Brazilian cultural fair with food stalls in Rio.

name: Mercado Modelo
description: Craft and snack stalls by Salvador’s Elevador Lacerda.

name: Mercado Central
description: A busy indoor market in Belo Horizonte with Minas cheeses and snacks.

name: Mercado Municipal de Curitiba
description: Curitiba’s market hall sells produce and casual Paraná kitchens.

name: Rio Carnival
description: Samba school parades fill the Sambadrome while street blocos take neighbourhoods.
